ibge2010anthropometry.title: Pesquisa de Orçamentos Familiares 2008-2009: Antropometria e estado nutricional de crianças, adolescentes e adultos no Brasil
decision_support: National median heights in Table 1.1: males 171.6 cm (30-34), 168.2 cm (55-64); females 160.0 cm (30-34), 156.6 cm (55-64).
limitations: Historical age-band estimates, not anthropometry measured in POF 2017-2018.

brasil2004sisvan.title: Vigilância alimentar e nutricional - SISVAN: orientações básicas para a coleta, processamento, análise de dados e informação em serviços de saúde
decision_support: Adult eutrophy at 18.5 <= BMI < 25; older-adult eutrophy at 22 < BMI < 27.
limitations: These classifications justify choosing reference BMI 24; they do not recommend one optimum BMI or diagnose the survey respondents.

nases2023energy.title: Dietary Reference Intakes for Energy
decision_support: Low-active adult EER equations, height in cm, mass in kg, age in years. Women: 575.77 - 7.01 age + 6.60 height + 12.14 weight. Men: 581.47 - 10.83 age + 8.30 height + 14.94 weight.
limitations: Prediction equations developed for United States and Canada; low-active status is a study assumption and not observed POF activity.

healthcanada2025vitamins.title: Dietary reference intakes tables: Reference values for vitamins
decision_support: Sex/age RDA and total-intake UL values, including vitamin D 2011 revision. A is RAE, E alpha-tocopherol, niacin NE.
limitations: Official web tables are the cited source. The NASEM vitamin summary PDF is supporting material. Upper limits for preformed A, synthetic niacin and supplemental vitamin E cannot be imposed on total food values. Folate DFE correspondence in POF remains unresolved.

healthcanada2025elements.title: Dietary reference intakes tables: Reference values for elements
decision_support: Sex/age RDA and total-intake UL for modeled minerals. Current potassium AI: women 2600 mg, men 3400 mg.
limitations: Official web tables include 2019 potassium and 2011 calcium revisions. Older NASEM elements-summary PDF supports unchanged mineral definitions but is not used for potassium. Magnesium UL concerns supplements, not ordinary dietary magnesium.

healthcanada2025macronutrients.title: Dietary reference intakes tables: Reference values for macronutrients
decision_support: Protein RDA 0.8 g/kg/day and AMDR 10-35% energy; total-fat AMDR 20-35%; sex/age fiber AI.
limitations: Official Health Canada tables are cross-checked against the supporting NASEM macronutrient PDF. Digestible carbohydrate is not separately identified by POF.

who2023fatsupdate.title: WHO updates guidelines on fats and carbohydrates
decision_support: Total fat <=30% energy; saturated fat <=10%; trans fat <=1%; adults >=25 g/day naturally occurring dietary fiber.
limitations: An official summary is used for these explicit numeric recommendations. Full guideline PDF retrieval returned non-PDF content.

who2012sodium.title: Guideline: sodium intake for adults and children
decision_support: Adult sodium maximum 2000 mg/day, corroborated by the official WHO 2013 release.
limitations: The full guideline PDF could not be retrieved as PDF. The endpoint is not mislabeled as a downloaded full text.
